title: Should Schools Start Later?
text:
Many students believe that schools should start later in the morning. They say that teenagers need more sleep to learn well. Doctors also support this idea because a tired brain has trouble paying attention.

Some teachers, however, disagree. They argue that a later start would make the school day end later, which could reduce time for sports and clubs. For this reason, the debate continues.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, why do teenagers need more sleep?
What do some teachers argue in paragraph two?
options: A later start would make the school day end later

questions.text: Why do doctors support a later school start time?
options: They think a tired brain has trouble paying attention
They want to work at night
Teachers asked them to support it

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the debate?
options: Schools have already changed their schedules
It has no clear answer yet
Students are not interested in it

vocabulary.definition: the ability to focus on something
to make something smaller or less
a discussion where people have different opinions
to give reasons to show that you are right

paragraph_translations: Muitos estudantes acreditam que as escolas deveriam começar mais tarde de manhã. Eles dizem que os adolescentes precisam dormir mais para aprender bem. Os médicos também apoiam essa ideia porque um cérebro cansado tem dificuldade em prestar atenção.

Alguns professores, no entanto, discordam. Eles argumentam que um início mais tarde faria o dia escolar terminar mais tarde, o que poderia reduzir o tempo para esportes e clubes. Por isso, o debate continua.
